batterySafety.note: 4.1 V is tracked as our preferred safer beta target. This compatibility record does not itself modify firmware or charger registers.

earlyWarning.behavior: warning beep when not on USB

shutdown.behavior: protected shutdown with debounce; not active while on USB

integrationPolicy: Control Center may display and validate these values when exposed by the device, but must not invent telemetry or write charger configuration without explicit verified protocol support.
